firstPlayerRule: The player who brought the most snacks starts the game.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from that player.
The starter deals each player one Companion card, followed by one Magic Item card, during setup.
internalEvidence: The Z-Man Games English booklet preserved by the LINCC library system was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 128174. Printed/PDF page 3 and the publisher credits on page 11 were rendered and visually checked. Page 3 selects the person who brought the most snacks, says play goes clockwise, and assigns that person the opening card deal. Page 11 identifies Z-Man Games and F2Z Entertainment ©2015.
